paper_name: Schedulability Analysis and Priority Assignment for Global Job-Level Fixed-Priority Multiprocessor Scheduling
paper_description: Proposes EQDF as JFP generalization of EDF balancing urgency and parallelism, with analysis and optimal/heuristic priority assignment via control knob, outperforming EDF empirically.

formal_description.statement: Quasi-deadline Q_{i,j} = d_{i,j} - alpha * C_i, where d_{i,j} abs deadline of job j of tau_i, C_i WCET, alpha in [0,1] knob.
EQDF schedulable if R_i <= D_i forall i, R_i = C_i + I_hp(R_i), I_hp interference from hp tasks.

informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def rta_eqdf(task_i, hp, alpha):
    R = task_i.C
    while True:
        I = sum(interf_j(task_j, R, alpha) for task_j in hp)
        new_R = task_i.C + I
        if new_R >= R: break
        R = new_R
    return R

formal_description.statement: Optimal alpha* maximizes schedulable tasksets via binary search on alpha.
